column4:
1. PAN / FOLLOW — BOY
From the forest side, camera pans/follows BOY as he climbs onto the bed, settling on him — tight MCU. 

2. APPARENT STATIC — JUMPING
Camera holds an apparently static tight MCU as BOY begins jumping on the bed. Each jump carries his head out of frame; he lands back into the same tight MCU. Initially facing the camera, BOY smiles. After several jumps, he naturally turns to the opposite side. Boy then drops to his knees, completely exiting frame.

3. WAIT / PAN-FOLLOW — BOY
Camera holds on the empty frame. After a beat, camera follows BOY down, finding him on his knees on the bed, head bowed.
column14:
MUST hit a consistent landing mark. 

Camera remains essentially static during the jump; minor operator adjustments only.
 
Hold for a beat before FOLLOW-DOWN to find him again.

Slight angle behind BOY. Full bed visible; BOY kneels on the bed, head down. Depth in the background, if possible.

Camera slowly pans from BOY toward WOMAN, stopping short of 180 degrees to reveal her standing beside a tree at the edge of the forest.
